Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root. It is the single source of instructions for every agent in this repo.

Copilot-specific: skills are in `.github/skills/` (a symlink to `.agents/skills/`). pstack was written for Cursor, so when it names a Cursor tool, use the closest Copilot equivalent (the Harness section of `.agents/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md` has the mappings). The `fusion` MCP tools hand work to the local model, Claude Code and Codex.
